Senses.Explanation: Heart-incense is a sincere inward offering made visible through a stick, pinch, or rising thread of incense. Masters say that a single piece or stick of heart-incense is burned before Kasyapa, ancestors, sovereigns, or memorial towers; the material burning and inward dedication are deliberately held together.
